name: multi-key-seal
intent: Three prerequisite keys arm in order, then triangular petals translate open along frozen angles.

copy.hintIdle: Press Run to arm the three key nodes.

reducedMotion.behaviour: All three keys appear armed and petals already open

acceptance: Exactly 3 keys arm at keyStepMs 150 before petals translate open over petalOpenMs 300
Petals open along petalAnglesDeg −90/30/150 by petalOffsetsPx [[0,-13],[11,7],[-11,7]] — not opacity fade
Core pulses once for corePulseMs 150 on OPEN; keys 1–3 manual arm in order
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) shows armed+open immediately
